Outcome-checked thought relabel: every thought opens with what the previous
action did, judged from consecutive screens.

positional arguments:
  corpus

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --apply               Write the rewrites (default is a dry run)
  --dry-run             Print old -> new and write nothing (default)
  --workers WORKERS
  --limit LIMIT
  --sample SAMPLE       Random subset of the targets (before --limit)
  --seed SEED
  --max-steps MAX_STEPS
                        Only trajectories with at most N steps
  --show SHOW           Steps printed per trajectory as OLD -> NEW
  --report-path REPORT_PATH
                        Also write a Markdown old/new table here
  --estimate            Print the full-run cost estimate and exit
